summary.case_id: Case 11: Shoulder closure on undivided highway

taper.formula_choice: Speed 40 mph < 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S^2 / 60
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-3. Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure, applied to undivided highway)

buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 305 ft (CDOT supplement silent at this speed)
buffer.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (stopping sight distance)

spacing.in_taper_text: 40 mph -> 40 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 40 mph -> 80 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 71 ft / 40 ft max spacing -> 4 drums at 23.7 ft intervals
spacing.tangent_count_text: 800 ft / 80 ft max spacing -> 11 cones at 80.0 ft intervals
spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 11 tangent + 2 downstream = 13 cones total

advance.road_type_text: Speed 40 mph, road_type = 'urban_low' -> Table 6B-1 category: urban_low

checks.label: Signs on both sides of divided highway
checks.detail: Required: False. Signs placed: 0 left, 6 right.

checks.label: G20-5P Work Zone signs every 2,640 ft
Speed reduction <= 15 mph per sign installation
checks.detail: No work-zone speed reduction. Posted speed 40 mph applies throughout the zone.

case.case: Case 11: Shoulder closure on undivided highway
case.narrative: This scenario follows CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Case 11 — the general shoulder-work typical (drawn for freeway/expressway) — applied to an undivided highway with single-side signing per CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 8.
case.narrative_2: The generated plan follows the same device layout as the reference case with spacing computed for 40 mph.
